finding.title: Producer source references are captured from disk by the CJS, not from the producer module at its own load
finding.counterexample: Fresh process: modify a private helper in scripts/historical-contract-repair-source.mjs (e.g. original(), leaving exported historicalContractRepairSourceSubject and readHistoricalContractRepairMember function text unchanged). Import that module first to cache its altered closures, then restore disk. Import CJS and owner afterward. CJS loadedImages reads the restored physical file; loadedProducerFunctionSha256 hashes the unchanged exported function text; both match the packet. The cold frame accepts and calls supplied read even though the cached private helper differs. The existing cachedproducer control changes an exported function body, so its failure does not cover this case.
finding.impact: Fails claimed full loaded repair-module identity and cold-before-callback contract; this does not establish a forged successful owner result.
finding.resolution: Capture authenticated load-image provenance inside each genuine producer module at its own evaluation, bind it to the same actual imported module identity and pinned expected image before callbacks, or use another demonstrably equivalent loader-bound provenance mechanism. Include preloaded private-helper-only mutation followed by restored disk in a fresh process, zero callback assertion, exact cleanup and healthy retry. Consider the threat boundary for self-attestation explicitly; data returned by code that itself can be arbitrarily altered cannot alone authenticate that code.
